goal: Find three reputable sources explaining the causes and effects of climate change, at least one of which must be a peer-reviewed scientific source and at least one of which must be a government or international body (e.g. NASA, NOAA, IPCC). A recent news segment claimed that global average temperatures have started decreasing over the past year. Verify this claim against your sources.
constraints: Provide three distinct sources, meeting the peer-reviewed and government/international body requirements above.
Summarize the main point of each source in your own words.
Distinguish scientific evidence from opinion or advocacy content within each source.
Explicitly state whether the temperature-decrease claim is supported or contradicted by the sources found.
If sources disagree with each other on any specific figure or claim, note the disagreement rather than picking one silently.
success_criteria: Three sources are provided, meeting the specified source-type requirements.
Each source is summarized in the agent's own words, not copied verbatim.
Evidence and opinion are explicitly distinguished for each source.
The temperature-decrease claim is directly addressed and correctly identified as false or unsupported.
Any disagreement between sources on specific figures is explicitly flagged.
expected_output: Three reputable, correctly-typed sources with concise summaries, an explicit fact-check of the false temperature-decrease claim, and any inter-source disagreements noted.
